summary: All 5 requested features passed. Backend: 7/7 new pytest tests pass, and node esim_renewal.test.js passes. Landing page: the phrase 'aren’t answered in CloudIVR yet' is gone from the whole DOM (FAQ <details> opened), from the product-card-mobile note and from the FAQ answer 'Can the USA mobile number make calls?'. Landing eSIM checkout (hero-order-esim) and mobile checkout (hero-order-mobile), signed out: co-method-switch shows Email and Phone number. Phone path: co-phone-name, co-phone-number and co-phone-send work. A simulated +1555 number gets a co-phone-preview-code. co-phone-verify creates the account and opens the Pay step (esim-co-pay; mobile-co-step shows 'Pay'). co-phone-wait counts down from 30s (30→27). After that co-phone-resend and co-phone-call appear. Resend gives a new code, and the new code works. Email signup in the checkout still reaches Pay. Daily offer: Alice's /offers/current is kind 'number' with the title '15% off a new VoIP number' and the VoIP-only note. dashboard-coupon-banner shows it. present() for renew and upgrade carries the note too. POST /esim and /mobile-numbers with a coupon field still charge the full $75 (checked on the wallet balance). French and Spanish: the Overview 'Suggested' line, Settings 'Suggestions on Overview', the auth method switch and 'Text me a code', the coupon banner (title and text), the auto-renew switch on/off text in the in-app eSIM and mobile buy forms, and the Buy page mobile-offer two-way SMS copy are all translated. Language was set back to English (localStorage civr.lang=en; language is stored only in the browser).

minor.issue: When the checkout name is left blank, the account is saved with name '' (an empty string) instead of null. Cosmetic.

design_issues.screen: In-app Buy page / eSIM page MobileOffer (pages/buy/MobileOffer.js:29)
issues: It still says 'Incoming calls aren’t answered in CloudIVR yet.' (the fr/es keys match it too). The user asked only for the landing page, so this is info only. Remove it if the app should match the landing page.

The eSIM card's testid is 'product-card-esim-card', while the mobile card's is 'product-card-mobile', so the naming is inconsistent. Card content is hidden until scroll (Reveal), so the tests used the hero-order-esim and hero-order-mobile buttons.
'$75 est prélevé' puts the $ before the amount, while other FR strings write '0,05 $'. Small inconsistency. fr.json also mixes 'pas la eSIM' (upgrade note) with 'pas l’eSIM' (number and renew notes).

action_items: Optional: decide whether to remove 'Incoming calls aren’t answered in CloudIVR yet.' from the in-app MobileOffer (and its fr/es keys) too.
Optional: unify the fr.json wording 'pas la eSIM' to 'pas l’eSIM'.
Optional: store a blank phone-signup name as null.
critical_code_review_comments: spenza.js remind() sets remindedFor before it sends the email or text. If sending fails, the reminder is never retried for that period (only the app alert is left). This is acceptable, but log or track the failures.
remind() puts the reminder text into the email HTML without escaping it. label(d) is server-built today; escape it if it can ever hold a user-set label.
Email takes priority over text as requested: email if acc.email, else sendText if acc.phone. sendText returns false in dry-run or when Telesign isn't configured, so nothing is sent in preview.
The ES.buy and buyMobile destructuring ignores any coupon field, which is correct by design.
seed_data_creation: Test phone and email accounts (TEST_iter200*, test_iter200_*@example.com, +1555 numbers) were created and then deleted together with their wallet, offer and esimLines records. The pytest teardown deletes them automatically. Alice's wallet dropped from about $380 to $324.79 over earlier iterations; this run did not charge Alice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Language is stored only in localStorage 'civr.lang' (settings-lang-{en,fr,es}), not on the server. Use hero-order-esim and hero-order-mobile to open the landing checkouts. Both checkouts use the shared Account component (testid esim-co-account) with co-method-email and co-method-phone. Phone-account _ids are stored as doubles (e.g. 5000000000000034.0); their chatId strings have no decimal. Spenza lines live in the 'esimLines' collection. Alice's offer today is kind 'number'.
